title: Set Up: Take a Flower Apart

scenes.tts: You need two or three simple, single flowers, a hand lens, tape, and a sheet of paper. For the bee game, add coloured sugar and cotton swabs.
scenes.narration: You need two or three simple, single flowers, a hand lens, tape, and a sheet of paper. For the bee game, add coloured sugar and cotton swabs.

scenes.tts: Pull off the sepals, then the petals, and tape each ring to the paper. Find the stalks with pollen. An adult slices across the swollen base of the middle part.
scenes.narration: Pull off the sepals, then the petals, and tape each ring to the paper. Find the stalks with pollen. An adult slices across the swollen base of the middle part.

scenes.tts: With the hand lens, look for tiny pale beads. Each one could become a seed if pollen reaches it. As the bee, your child carries colour from flower to flower.
scenes.narration: With the hand lens, look for tiny pale beads. Each one could become a seed if pollen reaches it. As the bee, your child carries colour from flower to flower.

scenes.tts: True lilies and daylilies can kill a cat. If a cat lives in or visits your home, do not bring them in. An adult does all the cutting.
